semantics.initial_terminal: already_terminal; no preceding winner is inferred
semantics.source_terminal_edges: retained as provenance, overridden by game termination
semantics.outside: unresolved in original game; exit stops the explicitly censored game
semantics.remoteness: W minimizes time to win; L maximizes delay; synchronous finite proof depth
semantics.policy: fastest W, longest-delay L, U-to-U-or-exit; signs -1 before +1

provenance.use: literal signed graph only; stochastic calculations and graph generation are not replayed
provenance.terminal_override: state 1 ends the game; its source edges remain provenance only

validation_scope: Source inspected and parsed before one new closure. Reader checks structure, graph/record identities and saved policy products only; it does not recompute retrograde outcomes or authenticate arbitrary edited certificates. W/L classifications lift to the original game conditional on the retained graph premise; remoteness is exact for the finite censored game/proof, not globally fastest original play. All retained stochastic work remains untouched.
